hero.title: Agentic Engineer · TypeScript & React
hero.subtitle: 12+ years in TypeScript, React and Node.js. Today AI agents write most of the code in a system I built myself, and I own the result: I slice the work, set acceptance criteria, test it and decide what ships. I help teams work the same way.

about.title: About me
about.bio: I started in 2013 with PHP and WordPress. Then I spent years building frontends in React and TypeScript, from startups to enterprise, and as Tech Lead at Gratified I led the development of a GPT-based chat system. Today I work as an agentic engineer: AI agents (Claude Code) write most of the code in a system I built myself — from planning, through test-first implementation and a multi-pass code review, to local CI and browser testing. I own what an agent can't judge: I slice the work, set acceptance criteria, test it and decide what ships. I bring this approach to teams as a consultant or as a team member: architecture, tooling choices, and a process where quality gates check the agents' work instead of trust.

services.title: How I Help
services.subtitle: Advisory built on 12+ years of shipping software, today with AI agents in a system I built myself

consulting.title: Architecture Consulting
consulting.description: Reviews of your TypeScript/React and Node.js architecture. I find bottlenecks, suggest patterns that scale, and help shape the code so AI agents can work in it safely: clear module boundaries, tests and contracts.

estimation.title: Project Estimation & Planning
estimation.description: Realistic estimates based on hands-on experience, from MVPs to complex systems: requirements analysis, risk assessment, and a plan split into small slices with acceptance criteria that can ship on their own.

development.title: Code Review & Mentoring
development.description: Better code quality for your team: thorough code reviews, workshops, and hands-on mentoring in TypeScript, React and Node.js. I also teach how to review code written by AI agents and how to set review rules that catch their typical mistakes.

ai.title: AI-Native Delivery
ai.description: I help teams ship with AI agents without losing quality: splitting work between people and agents, quality gates before every push, agent-run review and testing, and LLM integration in web apps.

workflow.title: How We Work Together
workflow.subtitle: A transparent process from first contact to project success. AI agents write the code; I own the result.

inquiry.title: Inquiry
inquiry.description: You describe your project, technical challenge or an open role. I reply quickly and we set up a short call.

nda.title: Signing the NDA
nda.description: We sign a non-disclosure agreement before I see any code or documents. We also agree which AI tools your code may go to, and which it may not.

scope.title: Scope & Acceptance Criteria
scope.description: We slice the work into small pieces that can ship on their own and write acceptance criteria for each. They are the contract the agents and I check the result against.

estimate.title: Estimate Approval
estimate.description: You get a transparent estimate broken down by slice. No hidden costs. Agents cut the time spent writing code, so you pay mostly for what needs a person: decisions, review and testing.

delivery.title: Delivery & Review
delivery.description: I deliver in small slices. AI agents write and review the code behind quality gates; I set the acceptance criteria, test it and decide what reaches you. Then we discuss findings and next steps.

success.title: Handover & Support
success.description: Goal achieved. You get working code with tests and a description of every change and, if you want, the agent workflow your team can keep using. If you need support later, you know where to find me.

playground.title: Shape workshop
playground.intro: Recreate a generated silhouette from blue squares. Cut, rotate, and arrange them like a tangram, then check the similarity score. AI agents built this game under my direction — a small example of how I work.
playground.sourceHint: Take identical blocks whenever you need them. Every block can be cut more than once.
playground.nothingSelected: Select a block on the board
playground.keyboardHelp: Block: drag or use the arrow keys. Shift moves precisely, Q/E rotates, C opens the cutter, and Delete returns the block.
playground.cutDescription: Tap two large handles on the edge in sequence. The blue preview is kept; you can flip the kept side before confirming.
playground.nextCutPoint: You are now choosing point {point} of the cutting line.
playground.cutInvalid: This line does not remove a useful part of the block. Choose different handles or flip the side.

status.ready: A target has been generated. Take your first square and start building.
status.added: A new square appeared on the right side of the board.
status.selected: Block selected. Drag, rotate, or cut it.
status.cutApplied: Cut complete. You can cut the same block again.
status.cutInvalid: The cut did not change the block. Choose another line.
status.removed: The block has returned to the source.
status.limit: There are enough blocks on the board. Return one before taking another.
status.scored: The summoner has judged your shape.
status.newRound: A new target is ready. Previously skipped shapes will not return in this pool.
status.poolRestarted: All 100 shapes have been used. A fresh pool has started without repeating the current shape.

results.excellent: You are really good with these blocks.
results.details: Next time, pay closer attention to the details.
results.effort: It looks like you did not put much effort into this one.
results.ignored: You simply could not be bothered.

resultMageAlt.excellent: The agent summoner looks on with pride, respect, and approval.
resultMageAlt.details: The agent summoner calmly accepts the expected result.
resultMageAlt.effort: The agent summoner crosses his arms and shows clear disappointment.
resultMageAlt.ignored: The agent summoner performs a deeply embarrassed facepalm.
resultMageAlt.hopeless: The agent summoner turns away and raises a hand to end the conversation.
